text_block_list.text: One day, while passing by the gymnasium――

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that! Everyone, project 
your voices more! Let the passion burst 
from the depths of your hearts!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds great♪ Well then, let's head 
to the next song! Let's gooo!

Seeking the Pearl was dancing onstage for 
some reason, and the students were happily 
watching. What a bizarre spectacle...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Today was super fun and amazing too, 
Pearl-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Um... It's my first time today, but I was 
really able to get into the groove...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that. Seeing 
everyone smile is my greatest treasure, 
after all♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you've wandered right into it. 
Into my solo show.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to help unleash the passion 
sleeping deep inside everyone even more.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why we hold these regularly. To get 
everyone active—and positive!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, having second thoughts? Don't worry, I 
won't force you into anything.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is surrender yourself 
to the music. Until the moment... you feel 
the rhythm...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, for our final song, can I get some 
energetic calls from everyone? Here we 
go――
